items.title: Meta Ads: $47.09 spend, 4 leads, $11.77 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: Yesterday (2026-08-13) Meta spent $47.09 across the only actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 4 leads at $11.77 CPL. That's below the 7-day baseline CPL (~$14.37 over $344.85 / 24 leads); account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged.

needs_attention: First run for meta-ads ingest — no prior meta-ads.json existed to check the gap against, so this run used the standard --days 1 (yesterday, 2026-08-13) window rather than widening.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 4 yesterday / 24 over the 7-day baseline, matching the counted leads exactly both times). No discrepancy today, but per the agent's trap note this should be reviewed for whether the script's lead-action set needs extending, not hand-patched here.
